summary: Make and deliver playable music videos from reusable templates, StickerBook-style asset packs, scene archetypes, deterministic motion/compositing, and optional generation providers.
requires: A finished song accessible to the host, either user-supplied or generated by an authorized capability
Enough visual capability to obtain source assets; still-image generation plus reusable asset packs/archetypes and the local compositor is sufficient for many videos
For local assembly: Python 3.10+, FFmpeg, FFprobe, and a writable workspace
A compatible media presentation surface only when inline playback is part of the requested delivery
Manim only when rendering Manim lyric overlays; the manifest compiler itself does not require Manim
inputs: A creative brief plus a song/audio source
A selected video template and style pack, plus reusable asset packs/archetypes when appropriate
For recurring actors: fixed 2x2 single-actor pose-sheet manifests with four typed poses
For reusable scenes: character-free scene templates whose actor slots declare accepted pose types, normalized anchors, scale, z-order, and occluders
Optional schema-2 actor pose states for gaze, mouth/vocal state, and held-object interaction
Optional lyric-overlay manifests compiled to deterministic Manim source for transparent graphics layers
For local assembly: one bounded JSON project manifest plus referenced local image/video assets
outputs: Deterministic four-cell crop receipts for actor pose sheets
Mechanical scene/pose compatibility results for named actor slots
Deterministic Manim source generated from bounded lyric-overlay manifests
For local rendering: a verified H.264/AAC MP4 and JPEG poster
JSON media facts including duration, dimensions, byte lengths, and SHA-256 values
An explicit delivery observation distinguishing file creation from inline-player success

enforced: Local renderer: at most 300 shots and 20 minutes of declared timeline
Local renderer: at most 120 seconds per shot and 60 frames per second
Local renderer: even output dimensions, at most 3840 pixels per side, and at most 3840x2160 total pixels
Local renderer: each local input at most 2 GiB and all local inputs together at most 10 GiB
Local renderer: manifest inputs must resolve inside the manifest directory
Local renderer: existing video or poster output is not replaced unless --force is explicit
Local renderer: audio duration and trimmed video-source durations are probed before rendering
operator: Use scripts/pose_sheet.py for fixed-grid actor extraction and scripts/scene_contract.py for pose/scene compatibility instead of visual guessing
Prefer reusable templates, asset packs, scene archetypes, and a limited module palette over inventing every shot from scratch
Prefer one high-value visual-generation atlas or pack over repeated isolated generations when continuity matters
Preserve scene-layer roles: actors, props/sets, occluders, effects, and environments remain separate until an archetype is composed
For recurring actors, prefer one subject per four-pose 2x2 sheet rather than large mixed-character atlases
Treat gaze and mouth/vocal state as refinements inside a compatible body pose instead of inventing new scene placement
For tightly held objects, prefer an actor+object interaction pack over layering a loose prop onto a generic actor pose
Before image generation for a production asset, write a visual-out brief with artifact role, downstream use, continuity locks, forbidden pixels, and acceptance checks
Reject a generated visual that is the wrong artifact class even if it is aesthetically strong
Do not require paid text-to-video access when still generation plus deterministic motion/compositing can satisfy the request
Keep provider inference spend, remote retrieval, account writes, and publishing inside the user's authorized task scope
Verify rights and task authority before using stock or third-party media
Do not claim inline playback until the current host actually exposes a player
Watch the complete export before making an artistic-quality claim when full playback is available
Treat Manim lyrics as transparent scene-agnostic overlays above compiled scenes, never as a replacement for actor/set generation

stop_when: The requested playable music video and poster are produced and the available review/delivery checks are complete
A genuinely required audio, visual-source, local-runtime, or requested delivery capability is absent
Another attempt would repeat a failed generation or render route without a concrete change
